_comment: Bot-defence question banks, keyed by topic. Each site (see MAUXY_SITES) maps to one topic. Questions are easy for a human in the site's audience, hard for a generic bot. 'answer' is the 0-based index of the correct choice. Add topics freely (e.g. 're-cloud'); a site with an unknown/empty topic cannot issue challenges.
